description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class representing floating rate data in a financial application. It encapsulates interest rate information, start date, and related periods for floating interest rates.

classes.name: FloatingRateDTO
classes.description: A DTO class for managing floating interest rate data including rate differences, start date, and associated rate periods.

methods.name: fetchBaseRate
methods.description: Returns the base interest rate for a given date by examining the relevant rate periods.

methods.name: addInterestRateDiff
methods.description: Adds a specified interest rate difference to the current interest rate difference.

methods.name: isFloatingInterestRate
methods.description: Indicates whether the interest rate is floating.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date for the floating rate.

methods.name: getInterestRateDiff
methods.description: Returns the current interest rate difference.

methods.name: getBaseLendingRatePeriods
methods.description: Returns the collection of base lending rate periods.

methods.name: resetInterestRateDiff
methods.description: Resets the interest rate difference to the actual interest rate difference.
